situation (example wording): "Countywide violent crime in Cook County", "all agencies in X County", "the Atlanta metro area"
what the app does today: A county name is P28's agency; county-wide and metro totals were not answered.
proposed behavior: A plain county name stays P28's county agency (the sheriff or county police), with a note that the cities in the county are not included. An explicit county-wide request ("countywide", "whole county", "all agencies in X County") is declined: no county-wide sum is given. The decline says whose figures the county's are and offers the question for that agency: "County-wide sums aren't given; the figures for Cook County are those of the Cook County Sheriff's Office." with "Ask instead: <the question without the county-wide words>". Where no county agency exists, the decline says so and offers nothing: "County-wide sums aren't given, and Crime Index has no agency for X County." Metro areas: declined.
exact default or choices offered: County-wide: declined, with the county's own agency (the sheriff or county police) offered. Metro: declined.
why: Jeff 2026-11-18 (through the coordinator): "Whenever a countywide sum is requested it decline and offer the primary county agency (county sheriff or police). That's the policy." This overrides the 2026-10-30 ruling ("We could add up all the agencies in a county or metro area, just makes me nervous since it isn't formal. Still, we should have that data.").
